_readme: INTERNAL WATCHLIST — not published to the site. The top China-origin store/restaurant
chains per category that are NOT already tracked, compiled 2026-09-29 from company/press/wiki
sources (four+ web-research passes). Store counts are APPROXIMATE and move fast.
status: 'us' = already operating in the US (candidate for new tracking); 'abroad' = operating
outside China but not the US (candidate for the international register); 'china' = China-only
(watch target — the expansion routine watches these for first overseas/US moves).
Already-tracked chains are excluded, EXCEPT where a tracked parent runs a DISTINCT sub-brand
(e.g. Lucky Cup = Mixue's coffee brand; Coucou = Xiabu's brand; Tan Yu = Jiumaojiu/Tai Er group).
Packaged-goods MAKERS and distribution-only brands (Three Squirrels, ChaCha, Weilong) are NOT
listed — the site tracks storefront chains, not products on a grocery shelf.
Excluded as non-Chinese-origin: Happy Lemon needs origin verification; Yonghe King (Jollibee),
RT-Mart (Taiwan), and HK-origin dessert/bakery brands were dropped by the research.
